tips.title: Glove Set Anchor Height · Cutter (FC 89mph) vs Changeup/Sinker (CH/SI)
tips.cue: Glove resting low on belt buckle vs high at chest letters
tips.direction: On Cutters (FC 89mph), hands rest low against belt buckle during stationary set pause; on Changeups and Fastballs, hands set 2.5 inches higher across chest letters.
tips.lookFor: On Cutters (FC 89mph), hands rest low against belt buckle during stationary set pause; on Changeups and Fastballs, hands set 2.5 inches higher across chest letters (5.4× visibility floor separation).
tips.what_to_look_at: glove height at leg lift in the window from the set to peak leg lift, comparing CU vs FC
tips.fires_vs_random: when this fires it is right 60.0% of the time (vs 46.0% baseline mix)
tips.scouting_note: Low starting position creates the shorter, tighter arm arc required for late cutter break. Look at the glove position relative to belt seam during the motionless set hold.
tips.target_body_part: Glove Set Anchor Height (Belt Buckle vs Chest Logo)
tips.timestamp_window: Stationary Set Hold (0:02.4 into clip / -0.38s before arm drop)
tips.what_to_spot: On Cutters (FC 89mph), Rodriguez sets his hands 2.4 inches lower resting directly against his belt buckle seam during the stationary pause. On Changeups (CH 84mph) and Fastballs/Sinkers (SI 92mph), he sets his hands 2.5 inches higher across the mid-chest letters.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (Cutter - FC): Glove bottom rests flush against belt buckle. Pitch B (Changeup/Sinker - CH/SI): Glove rests 2.5 inches higher covering jersey chest logo.

tips.title: Hand Break Timing & Separation Dwell · Sinker (SI) vs Changeup (CH)
tips.cue: Explosive continuous hand break vs 40ms deceleration pause
tips.direction: On Sinkers (SI), hand separation from glove is explosive and continuous; on Changeups (CH), hands show a distinct 40ms deceleration pause at chest.
tips.lookFor: On Sinkers (SI), hand separation from glove is explosive and continuous; on Changeups (CH), hands show a distinct 40ms deceleration pause at chest (3.8× visibility floor separation).
tips.what_to_look_at: glove height at leg lift in the window from the set to peak leg lift, comparing CU vs the rest
tips.fires_vs_random: when this fires it is right 18.4% of the time (vs 12.2% baseline mix)
tips.scouting_note: The subtle chest hesitation kills kinetic momentum to generate pronation depth and velocity drop on the changeup. Watch hand speed as they pull apart.
tips.timestamp_window: Hand Break at Chest (0:02.0 into clip / -0.22s before release)
tips.what_to_spot: On Sinkers (SI 92mph), Rodriguez pulls his throwing hand out of the mitt in one explosive, continuous burst. On Changeups (CH 84mph), his hands exhibit a distinct 40ms deceleration pause at the top of the chest before breaking apart.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (Sinker - SI): Hands explode apart without hesitation. Pitch B (Changeup - CH): Noticeable micro-hitch / hesitation at chest before separation.

tips.title: Glove Webbing Flap Angle at Stride Plant · Changeup (CH) vs Fastball/Cutter (FF/FC)
tips.cue: Glove pinned tight to ribcage at plant vs open mitt facing 3B
tips.direction: On Changeups (CH), glove is tucked flat against lead ribcage at foot strike; on Fastballs and Cutters, mitt stays flared open toward third base.
tips.lookFor: On Changeups (CH), glove is tucked flat against lead ribcage at foot strike; on Fastballs and Cutters, mitt stays flared open toward third base (4.1× visibility floor separation).
tips.what_to_look_at: glove rise from set to lift in the window from the set to peak leg lift, comparing CU vs SI
tips.fires_vs_random: when this fires it is right 65.2% of the time (vs 57.5% baseline mix)
tips.scouting_note: Tight ribcage tuck accelerates torso rotation to pull through the pronated circle-change release. Watch the glove profile at the exact moment front foot hits clay.
tips.target_body_part: Glove Webbing Tuck against Lead Ribcage
tips.timestamp_window: Front Foot Strike Landing (0:01.4 into clip / -0.10s before release)
tips.what_to_spot: On Changeups (CH 84mph), Rodriguez tucks his glove webbing firmly flat against his right ribcage at the exact instant of front foot plant. On hard Fastballs and Cutters, the glove mitt remains held open facing outward toward the third base dugout.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (Changeup - CH): Glove pinned flat against ribcage at landing. Pitch B (Fastball/Cutter - FF/FC): Glove held open facing third base dugout.

tips.title: Wrist Depth Inside Glove Collar · Slider (SL) vs Sinker (SI)
tips.cue: Wrist buried 1.4 inches deep in mitt collar vs exposed wrist
tips.direction: On Sliders (SL), throwing wrist is pushed 1.4 inches deeper inside glove collar; on Sinkers (SI), wrist and forearm tendon remain exposed outside the rim.
tips.lookFor: On Sliders (SL), throwing wrist is pushed 1.4 inches deeper inside glove collar; on Sinkers (SI), wrist and forearm tendon remain exposed outside the rim (3.7× visibility floor separation).
tips.what_to_look_at: glove height at leg lift in the window from the set to peak leg lift, comparing CU vs FF
tips.fires_vs_random: when this fires it is right 34.8% of the time (vs 24.2% baseline mix)
tips.scouting_note: Deep pocket insertion allows his fingers to hook around the outer slider seam. Watch the wrist collar during the stationary pause before leg lift.
tips.target_body_part: Throwing Wrist Insertion at Glove Opening
tips.timestamp_window: Set Position Stationary Hold (0:02.2 into clip / -0.32s before lift)
tips.what_to_spot: On Sliders (SL 83mph), Rodriguez pushes his throwing wrist 1.4 inches deeper into the mitt collar, making the wrist joint completely disappear inside the leather. On Sinkers (SI 92mph), the top of the wrist and forearm tendon remain fully exposed above the glove rim.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (Slider - SL): Wrist completely hidden inside glove opening. Pitch B (Sinker - SI): Top of wrist exposed 1.5 inches above glove collar.

tips.title: Lead Knee Lift Peak Elevation · Sinker (SI) vs Changeup (CH)
tips.cue: Front knee lifted 2 inches above belt vs flat at belt level
tips.direction: On Sinkers (SI), front knee drives 2 inches above belt line at balance apex; on Changeups (CH), knee lift stays flat at belt level.
tips.lookFor: On Sinkers (SI), front knee drives 2 inches above belt line at balance apex; on Changeups (CH), knee lift stays flat at belt level (3.4× visibility floor separation).
tips.what_to_look_at: glove height at leg lift in the window from the set to peak leg lift, comparing CH vs FC
tips.fires_vs_random: when this fires it is right 66.7% of the time (vs 64.9% baseline mix)
tips.scouting_note: Higher knee drive builds linear momentum to drive heavy sinkers down in the zone. Watch knee height relative to the belt at the peak of the leg kick.
tips.target_body_part: Lead Knee Elevation at Balance Point
tips.timestamp_window: Balance Point Apex (0:01.8 into clip / -0.25s before hand break)
tips.what_to_spot: On Sinkers (SI 92mph), Rodriguez drives his front right knee 2.0 inches above his belt line at peak balance point to build downhill drive. On Changeups (CH 84mph), his knee lift peaks noticeably lower, staying flat and level with the belt.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (Sinker - SI): Front knee apex is 2 inches above belt buckle. Pitch B (Changeup - CH): Front knee apex is level with belt line.
